en: Color postcard with a burgundy frame showing a statue in front of a large Romanesque-style cathedral with multiple towers and arched windows, bordered by a flowerbed of red tulips under a blue sky. The word "PÉCS" is printed prominently on the front. The reverse side has space for address and stamp, multilingual greetings from Pécs, a barcode, publisher information, and the word "Bazilika".
